The system uses an API Gateway as the single entry point, ensuring secure and controlled

● Authentication: All access is secured using Token-based authentication

The platform is composed of specialized, decoupled services: 
● Auth Service: Manages user sessions and is responsible for issuing and validating

● Payment Service: Integrates with payment providers, manages retries, and includes 
error handling. It uses synchronous confirmation to avoid discrepancies.
